name: Lettuce

basicInfo.description: Lettuce is a cool-season leafy green that grows quickly and is ideal for beginners. It thrives in small spaces and can be harvested in just 6–8 weeks.
whyGrow: Great for fresh salads and wraps
Can be grown in containers or small gardens
basicInfo.sunlight: 4-6 hours of sun, tolerates partial shade
basicInfo.water: Keep soil consistently moist but not waterlogged

growingSteps: Prepare loose, fertile soil with compost
Sow seeds 0.5 cm deep directly outdoors or in containers
Thin seedlings to allow proper spacing
Water regularly to keep soil moist
Harvest outer leaves first or the full head after 6-8 weeks

careCalendar.description: Plant seeds directly in garden soil or containers.
Remove weaker sprouts, leaving 20cm between plants.
Check soil daily and water when the top feels dry.
Cut outer leaves and let the rest keep growing.

solutions: Harvest regularly to reduce hiding spots

harvestingGuide: Harvest lettuce by cutting outer leaves when they reach 10–15 cm, or harvest the full head at once after 6–8 weeks. Regular picking encourages continuous growth.
estimatedSavings: Growing lettuce at home can save $50–80 per season, especially if you eat salads regularly.
